name: AM-356
summary: Methanandamide (AM-356) is a synthetically created stable chiral analog of anandamide with improved metabolic stability.g. Hydra).

pharmacology.text: Its effects have been observed to act on the cannabinoid receptors (specifically on CB1 receptors, which are part of the central nervous system) found in different organisms such as mammals, fish, and certain invertebrates (e.g. Hydra).

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the endocannabinoid system in mammals and in other animals, including fish and invertebrates. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用來探討哺乳類以及魚類和無脊椎動物等其他動物的內源性大麻素系統，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用来探讨哺乳类以及鱼类和无脊椎动物等其他动物的内源性大麻素系统，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Cannabinoid receptor agonists as a class can cause a racing heart, dizziness, dry mouth, anxiety and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。大麻素受體促效劑作為一類，可能造成心跳急促、頭暈、口乾、焦慮與混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。大麻素受体促效剂作为一类，可能造成心跳急促、头晕、口干、焦虑与混乱。

fact.en: It is a sturdier copy of anandamide, one of the cannabinoids the body makes itself. Anandamide is named after ananda, the Sanskrit word for bliss, and the body breaks it down very quickly.
fact.zh: 它是身體自製大麻素之一「內源性大麻素 anandamide」的強化版。Anandamide 的名稱來自梵文的「ananda」，意為極樂，而身體會非常迅速地分解它。
fact.zhHans: 它是身体自制大麻素之一「内源性大麻素 anandamide」的强化版。Anandamide 的名称来自梵文的「ananda」，意为极乐，而身体会非常迅速地分解它。
